subject: Culture
title: Why Christmas Moved to December
description: A short lesson to help you apply Why Christmas Moved to December.

hook.text: The Bible never names Jesus's birthday. December 25th was chosen for strategic, not historical, reasons.

buildup.text: Early Christians celebrated Easter, not Christmas. The birth date wasn't important for the first 300 years.

discovery.text: Roman authorities placed it near the winter solstice to compete with Sol Invictus, the sun-god festival.

twist.text: Puritans actually banned Christmas in 1644. They saw it as too pagan and too rowdy.

climax.text: Christmas became the world's biggest holiday not through theology but through timing and marketing.

punchline.text: The date was a marketing decision, not a miracle.
